526bb34a38a7d25b800ac8e0792467a1ce20e17e.summary: A DomainTools blog post describing how an analyst pivoted from a privacy-protected domain that triggered a YARA rule to its hosting IP, then to a Word document lure and a phishing page styled as an Israeli Prime Minister's office SSL VPN login. The report says some indicators point to the CopyKitten group, but it declines nation-state attribution.
